name: Kidney Bean Chili with Melty Cheddar & Cornbread Topping

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and small dice bell peppers. Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and quarter the jalapeños lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely mince. (Be careful, with jalapeños, do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing).
Preheat an extra-large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add bell peppers, garlic, onions, and jalapeños to the skillet; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 5-7 minutes.
Add beans, tomatoes, water, tomato paste, and spices to the skillet. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the cornbread batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
1 cup water
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp oregano
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in a microwave or saucepan. Once melted, add to a medium bowl.

Add milk and eggs to the bowl with the butter and whisk to combine. In a separate medium bowl, stir together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add wet ingredients to the bowl with the dry ingredients and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml whole milk
3 eggs
¾ cup polenta (cornmeal)
¾ cup all-purpose flour
⅓ cup brown sugar
¾ tsp baking powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle cheese over the bean mixture. Pour cornbread batter on top and smooth into a thin layer with a spatula.
Place skillet in the oven and bake until cornbread is golden and cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
To serve, divide chili and cornbread between bowls and enjoy!
